claims: TPC Sawgrass is located in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
Ponte Vedra Beach is a coastal community about 25 miles southeast of Jacksonville.
TPC Sawgrass is the home of The Players Championship.
The Players Championship features the Stadium Course.
The Stadium Course has an island green 17th hole.
The official address of TPC Sawgrass is 110 Championship Way, Ponte Vedra Beach, FL 32082.
Jacksonville International Airport (JAX) is about a 60-minute drive from TPC Sawgrass.
